snippet.title: UMAMI | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
UMAMI is a 3D food-themed puzzle game where every level is a hand-crafted sensory experience! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669360/UMAMI/
Tinker, rotate, and fit wooden blocks together to build mouthwatering food towers and complete charming levels; like tidying a bento box for the soul!

🍡 Discord - https://discord.gg/BnA8CsPAtB
🍰 Twitter / X - https://x.com/mimmoxgames
🍣 Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/mimmox.bsky.social

#indiegames #cozygames #wholesomegames #puzzlegame
